PRAYING TO QUASH THE ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE PETITIONER (ACCUSED NO.1), PENDING BEFORE THE COURT OF CHIEF METROPOLITAN MAGISTRATE, BENGALURU IN C.C.NO.3855/2023 FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/S 498A, 323, 504, 506 R/W SECTION 34 OF IPC, SECTIONS 3 AND 4 OF THE D.P. ACT,
(ANNEXURE-A)
 THIS CRIMINAL PETITION COMING ON FOR REPORTING SETTLEMENT, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Learned HCGP accepts notice for respondent No.1-State.
2.
Sri G. Mohan Kumar, learned counsel files power on behalf of respondent No.2 and the same is placed on record.
3. The petitioner-accused No.1 is sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under sections 498A 323, 504, 506 r/w 34 IPC, and Sections 3 and 4, 6 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

4. The case of the prosecution is that, the petitioner- accused No.1 who is the husband, subjected the defacto- complainant to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and also a demand was made to bring money from her parental home.

5. The parties are present before this Court and have filed an application under Section 320 r/w 482 of Cr.P.C. for compounding of the offences stating that they have filed a joint petition before the Family Court, Udupi for dissolution of their marriage in M.C. No.233/2023, and respondent No.2 - defacto complainant has agreed to withdraw all the allegations made NC: 2023:KHC:45970 against the petitioner and stated that she has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings.
6. The application is placed on record.

sentences.text: Though the offences alleged against the petitioner- accused herein are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that the parties have amicably settled the dispute among themselves, and the respondent No.2 having no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioner is subjected to trial, since the probability of his conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.
Therefore, the continuation of the criminal proceedings will be an abuse of the process of law.
